id: 3d4e5f60-7a8b-4c1d-9e2f-0a1b2c3d4e51
description: Detects a Ruby-family parent process spawning powershell.exe with -ExecutionPolicy bypass, matching the SleeperGem gem load-path dropper handing a downloaded script to PowerShell.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/sleepergem-rubygems-supply-chain-attack
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/07/21
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\ruby.exe'
      - '\gem'
      - '\bundle.exe'
      - '\rake'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'ExecutionPolicy'
      - 'bypass'
  condition: selection
level: high
2741.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("ruby.exe","ruby","gem","bundle","bundler","rake","irb") AND Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","sh","bash","dash","zsh")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| where match(process,"(?i)-ExecutionPolicy\s+bypass") OR process_name IN ("sh","bash","dash","zsh")
| sort - lastTime
2741.datadog: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\ruby.exe OR *\Ruby.exe OR *\gem OR *\bundle OR *\rake) @Image:(*\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\pwsh.exe) @CommandLine:(*ExecutionPolicy* AND *bypass*)
2741.falcon:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/^(ruby|gem|bundle|bundler|rake|irb)(\.exe)?$/i
| ImageFileName=/(powershell|pwsh)\.exe$/i
| CommandLine=/-ExecutionPolicy\s+bypass/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine], function=count())
